sentences.en: time.

sentences.en: Frame.

sentences.en: And the Brannock device has always seemed to me to be prototypically, classically inconspicuous.
sentences.zh: 而布兰诺克测量仪在我看来，一直都是那种典型且经典的不起眼之物。

sentences.en: I think it's fair to say there's probably nobody listening to this podcast episode right now
sentences.zh: 我觉得可以肯定地说，现在收听这期播客的人里，

sentences.en: whose foot has not been in a Brannock device at some point.
sentences.zh: 大概没有谁的脚没被放进过布兰诺克测量仪里。

sentences.en: It's pretty much a universal touchstone in our culture, and yet nobody knows what it's

sentences.en: called, or almost nobody.

sentences.en: So that means it is simultaneously ubiquitous and anonymous.

sentences.zh: 保罗对布兰诺克测量仪的痴迷始于 1992 年，当时他读到了

sentences.en: It was sort of a perfect confluence of an impulse I had with the ultimate example of that impulse,

sentences.en: object.

sentences.en: The inventor's name was Charles Brannock.
sentences.zh: 发明者的名字叫查尔斯·布兰诺克。

sentences.en: He was born in 1903 in Syracuse, New York.
sentences.zh: 他于 1903 年出生在纽约州雪城。

sentences.en: Charles Brannock had shoes and shoe sales in his blood, you might say.
sentences.zh: 可以说，查尔斯·布兰诺克的血液里流淌着鞋子和鞋类销售的基因。

sentences.en: His father co-owned the Park Brannock Shoe Store, the one from the beginning of the story.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲是公园布兰诺克鞋店（Park Brannock Shoe Store）的合伙人，就是故事开头提到的那家店。

sentences.en: Charles worked there while he was in high school.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯在高中时就在那里工作。

sentences.en: It occurred to him that there was a need for better shoe sizing, that a lot of people
sentences.zh: 他意识到需要更好的鞋码测量工具，因为很多人

sentences.en: complained that their shoes didn't fit properly or they were uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 抱怨他们的鞋子不合脚或者穿着不舒服。

sentences.en: The other devices at the time were just glorified yardsticks that measured only length or just
sentences.zh: 当时的其它设备不过是美化版的直尺，只能测量长度，或者侧过来测量

sentences.en: length and width if you turned it sideways.
sentences.zh: 长度和宽度。

sentences.en: Nothing measured that critical dimension of arch length.
sentences.zh: 没有任何设备能测量足弓长度这一关键维度。

sentences.en: And so while he was in college in his early 20s at Syracuse University, he sort of had an
sentences.zh: 所以，当他在雪城大学读大学，二十出头的时候，他产生了一种

sentences.en: impulse to try to create such a device.
sentences.zh: 冲动，想要尝试创造出这样一种装置。

sentences.en: And his college roommate would recall that he would wake up in the middle of the night,
sentences.zh: 他的大学室友回忆说，他经常在半夜醒来，

sentences.en: two or three in the morning.
sentences.zh: 凌晨两三点钟。

sentences.en: And there was Charlie Brannock sitting at a desk with the light on, scribbling notes and
sentences.zh: 查理·布兰诺克就坐在书桌前，开着灯，涂涂写写，

sentences.en: making drawings.
sentences.zh: 画着草图。

sentences.en: And his roommate would say, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 他的室友会问，你在干什么？

sentences.en: You're keeping me up at night.
sentences.zh: 你吵得我睡不着觉。

sentences.en: And Charlie would say, you know, I had an idea for the invention.
sentences.zh: 查理会说，你知道，我有个发明点子。

sentences.en: I'm working on this thing and I have to write it down or I might forget.
sentences.zh: 我正在研究这个东西，我得把它写下来，不然可能会忘。

sentences.en: So that thing that comes up with, the Brannock device, could you describe it?
sentences.zh: 那么，那个他想出来的东西，布兰诺克测量仪，你能描述一下吗？

sentences.en: You have one next to you.
sentences.zh: 你旁边就有一个。

sentences.en: Of course you do.
sentences.zh: 当然有。

sentences.en: So it's a metal object.
sentences.zh: 它是一个金属物体。

sentences.en: It has two sort of cupped areas, one at each end.
sentences.zh: 它有两处类似杯状的区域，两端各一个。

sentences.en: And that's so you can put your heel to measure one foot in this sort of cupped receptacle
sentences.zh: 那是为了让你把脚后跟放进这个杯状容器里来测量一只脚，

sentences.en: and then turn the Brannock device around to do the other foot.
sentences.zh: 然后转动布兰诺克测量仪来测量另一只脚。

sentences.en: It has one sliding piece that moves backward and forward to measure the width of your foot.
sentences.zh: 它有一个可以前后滑动的部件，用来测量脚的宽度。

sentences.en: And then it has another sliding piece to measure your arch length.
sentences.zh: 还有一个滑动部件用来测量足弓长度。

sentences.en: And then it has yet another sliding piece for the length of your foot.
sentences.zh: 还有一个滑动部件用来测量脚的长度。

sentences.en: So it's metal.
sentences.zh: 所以它是金属做的。

sentences.en: The one I'm holding is made of aluminum, which has been the case for decades now.
sentences.zh: 我手里拿的这个是铝制的，几十年来一直如此。

sentences.en: They've been made out of aluminum.
sentences.zh: 它们一直都是用铝制造的。

sentences.en: I believe the early ones were made of steel and it feels solid, but not too heavy.
sentences.zh: 我相信早期的版本是钢制的，摸起来很扎实，但又不会太重。

sentences.en: And I don't know how else to say this.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么形容。

sentences.en: It just looks like it knows what it's doing.
sentences.zh: 它看起来就像是那种很专业的设备。

sentences.en: It looks so official and professional and it has so many calibrations and numbers on it.
sentences.zh: 它看起来非常正式、专业，上面有那么多的刻度和数字。

sentences.en: I mean, that could just be nonsense, right?
sentences.zh: 我是说，那可能只是胡乱标上去的，对吧？

sentences.en: You could just put a lot of ruled lines and numerals on things and just make it seem like,
sentences.zh: 你完全可以在东西上画很多刻度线和数字，让它看起来像，

sentences.en: you know, a thermometer or a barometer or something like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，像温度计、气压计之类的东西。

sentences.en: But it has this feel of a finely tuned, finely calibrated instrument.
sentences.zh: 但它确实给人一种精密调校、精准测量仪器的感觉。

sentences.en: And it is.
sentences.zh: 事实也确实如此。

sentences.en: It's hard to pin down the exact birth date of the Brannock device.
sentences.zh: 很难确定布兰诺克测量仪的确切诞生日期。

sentences.en: But Paul says an early version was definitely in use by 1925.
sentences.zh: 但保罗说，到1925年时，早期版本肯定已经投入使用了。

sentences.en: And again, that was really the point.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这才是重点。

sentences.en: Charles Brannock invented this not to be an industry tool, but to give his family shoe store
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·布兰诺克发明这个东西并不是为了成为行业工具，而是为了给自家的鞋店

sentences.en: a competitive sales advantage.
sentences.zh: 提供竞争优势。

sentences.en: But other stores did take notice.
sentences.zh: 但其他商店确实注意到了它。

sentences.en: And soon there was demand from other outlets, not just in Syracuse, but out of town, around the country.
sentences.zh: 很快，其他销售点也产生了需求，不仅是在雪城，还有外地，乃至全国各地。

sentences.en: So Brannock filed a patent that wouldn't be granted until 1928.
sentences.zh: 于是布兰诺克申请了专利，直到1928年才获批。

sentences.en: But in the meantime, he got busy.
sentences.zh: 但在此期间，他已经忙碌起来了。

sentences.en: He initially thought he would just need a handful of prototypes to use at his family store.
sentences.zh: 他最初以为只需要几个原型机在自家店里用就行了。

sentences.en: But now that there was a demand, he needed to create a company.
sentences.zh: 但既然有了需求，他就得成立一家公司。

sentences.en: And so he launched the Brannock device company in Syracuse to manufacture these things.
sentences.zh: 于是他在雪城创办了布兰诺克测量仪公司来生产这些东西。

sentences.en: It's almost a quaint idea of how invention works.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是一种关于发明如何运作的古朴理念。

sentences.en: Charles Brannock saw a need.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·布兰诺克看到了需求。

sentences.en: He made a thing and people wanted it.
sentences.zh: 他制造了一个东西，人们想要它。

sentences.en: So Brannock manufactured more and sold them to people who needed them.
sentences.zh: 于是布兰诺克制造了更多，并卖给了有需要的人。

sentences.en: And as demand grew, the Brannock company grew with it.
sentences.zh: 随着需求的增长，布兰诺克公司也随之壮大。

sentences.en: Well, let's put it this way.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们可以这样说。

sentences.en: If it was launched in Syracuse in 1925, by 1929, international sales were starting.
sentences.zh: 如果它是在1925年于雪城推出的，那么到1929年，国际销售就已经开始了。

sentences.en: OK, so not just around the country, but around the world or at least across the ocean in Europe.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以不仅是在全国，甚至是在全世界，或者至少是跨越大洋到了欧洲。

sentences.en: So that's a pretty big deal.
sentences.zh: 这可是件了不起的大事。

sentences.en: Charles Brannock developed a junior model because kids' feet are not just smaller than adult feet.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·布兰诺克开发了青少年型号，因为孩子的脚不仅比成人的脚小，

sentences.en: They're proportioned differently.
sentences.zh: 而且比例也不同。

sentences.en: Brannock took his role in shoe fitting very seriously.
sentences.zh: 布兰诺克非常认真地对待他在鞋类适配中的角色。

sentences.en: He had this quote early in his Brannock career where he said,
sentences.zh: 他在布兰诺克职业生涯早期曾说过这样一句话：

sentences.en: The shoe salesman, like a doctor, has a distinct responsibility to his customers.
sentences.zh: 鞋店售货员就像医生一样，对顾客负有特殊的责任。

sentences.en: A mistake in the fitting of a shoe, particularly a child's, can easily endanger a person's health.
sentences.zh: 鞋子尺码不合，尤其是对孩子来说，很容易危害到个人的健康。

sentences.en: The misfitted feet of today are the crippled feet of tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 今天不合脚的鞋，就是明天残疾的脚。

sentences.en: The junior model came out in 1933.
sentences.zh: 青少年款是在1933年推出的。

sentences.en: And that same year, Brannock got his big break.
sentences.zh: 同年，布兰诺克迎来了他的重大机遇。

sentences.en: A United States Navy ship's captain noticed that his sailors were complaining a lot of ill-fitting shoes.
sentences.zh: 一位美国海军舰长注意到，他的水兵们经常抱怨鞋子不合脚。

sentences.en: So he knew of the Brannock device.
sentences.zh: 于是他了解到了布兰诺克测量仪。

sentences.en: It's not clear if he was from Syracuse or, you know, if he had just encountered it at another shoe store.
sentences.zh: 不清楚他是来自雪城，还是说，你知道，他只是在另一家鞋店偶然发现了它。

sentences.en: And he had his sailors, when they were docked somewhere, refitted with a Brannock device.
sentences.zh: 当水兵们在某处停靠时，他让他们用布兰诺克测量仪重新测量了尺码。

sentences.en: And he was so happy with the results because his sailors were no longer complaining,
sentences.zh: 他对结果非常满意，因为水兵们不再抱怨了，

sentences.en: that he wrote an article in the July 1933 issue of a publication called United States Naval Institute Proceedings,
sentences.zh: 以至于他在1933年7月出版的《美国海军学会学报》上写了一篇文章，

sentences.en: where he described how the Brannock device had eliminated foot troubles aboard his ship.
sentences.zh: 在文中他描述了布兰诺克测量仪是如何消除他舰上官兵的足部问题的。

sentences.en: Charles Brannock heard about the article, and ever the believer in his own invention, he sent copies of it to important people around the armed forces.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·布兰诺克听说了这篇文章，作为自己发明的忠实信徒，他将文章副本寄给了军队里的重要人物。

sentences.en: Pretty soon, most branches of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 很快，美国军队的大多数分支机构

sentences.en: military were using Brannock devices to outfit their service members.
sentences.zh: 都在使用布兰诺克测量仪为他们的服役人员配备鞋履。

sentences.en: Then, on December 7th, 1941, Japan attacked Pearl Harbor, and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 随后，1941年12月7日，日本袭击了珍珠港，美国

sentences.en: entered World War II.
sentences.zh: 加入了第二次世界大战。

sentences.en: Suddenly, there's a huge demand because there's a huge surge in enlistment in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，需求量激增，因为美国的入伍人数

sentences.en: armed forces.
sentences.zh: 出现了巨大的增长。

sentences.en: And the military wants Brannock devices because they need to fit all these people.
sentences.zh: 军方需要布兰诺克测量仪，因为他们需要为所有这些人测量尺码。

sentences.en: And Brannock makes a modification.
sentences.zh: 于是布兰诺克进行了一项改进。

sentences.en: Instead of the single Brannock device, which you turn around to measure each foot, you know, you put your heel in one end to do the right foot and the other end for the left foot,
sentences.zh: 不再使用那种需要转来转去测量每只脚的单体布兰诺克测量仪，你知道，就是把脚后跟放在一端测右脚，另一端测左脚，

sentences.en: he comes up with a double Brannock device, which is sort of two Brannock devices mounted on a board.
sentences.zh: 他发明了一种双体布兰诺克测量仪，基本上就是把两个测量仪安装在了一块板子上。

sentences.en: And I actually have one of these that was made for the Air Force.
sentences.zh: 我实际上就有一个这种为美国空军制造的测量仪。

sentences.en: And the idea is that if you have all these new enlistees and they're sort of marching through, getting fitted for uniforms, and you're giving them their crew cut and all that,
sentences.zh: 其构想是，如果你有这么多新兵，他们正排队走过来，准备领取制服，还要理发什么的，

sentences.en: you know, so that they can, you know, go off to war, you can't waste time turning the device around.
sentences.zh: 你知道，为了让他们能尽快奔赴战场，你不能浪费时间去转动测量仪。

sentences.en: Of course not.
sentences.zh: 当然不能。

sentences.en: And so you have this double Brannock device so that they can have both feet measured simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 所以你有了这种双体布兰诺克测量仪，这样他们就可以同时测量双脚。

sentences.en: And it's more efficient.
sentences.zh: 效率更高。

sentences.en: It's faster.
sentences.zh: 速度更快。

sentences.en: I mean, there's a funny, there's like an old, I don't know where this comes from, some general that says like an army marches on his stomach,
sentences.zh: 我是说，有个有趣的说法，是个老话，我不知道出处在哪，有位将军说军队是靠胃行军的，

sentences.en: like meaning that you have to keep the troops well fed.
sentences.zh: 意思是说你必须让军队吃饱饭。

sentences.en: But the truth is, is that armies march on their feet.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，军队是靠脚行军的。

sentences.en: Yeah, like your boots and your shoes.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是靠你的靴子和鞋子。

sentences.en: It's a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这非常重要。

sentences.en: And I like to say that's how Charles Brannock helped defeat fascism.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢说，这就是查尔斯·布兰诺克帮助击败法西斯的方式。

sentences.en: You know, it's in like, it's literally true.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这在某种程度上，是完全真实的。

sentences.en: He had a role in U.S.
sentences.zh: 他在美国的军事准备和动员中发挥了作用。

sentences.en: military preparedness and the call to action.
sentences.zh: 今天的布兰诺克测量仪与查尔斯·布兰诺克在20世纪20年代中期在他父亲鞋店里推出的那款非常接近。

sentences.en: The Brannock device of today is very close to the one Charles Brannock introduced in his father's shoe store in the mid 1920s.
sentences.zh: 多年来他确实做了一些小的改进，但没有重大的改动。

sentences.en: He did make small refinements over the years, but nothing major.
sentences.zh: 他其实不需要做太多改变，因为布兰诺克测量仪就是我们现在所说的“品类杀手”。

sentences.en: And he didn't really need to make many changes because the Brannock device was what we would now call a category killer.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那个年代还没有这个词，但它基本上消灭了竞争对手。

sentences.en: You know, that term didn't exist back in his day, but it essentially wiped out the competition.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人能真正挑战它的地位。

sentences.en: Nobody ever seriously challenged it.
sentences.zh: 它确实是，而且至今仍是行业标杆。

sentences.en: And it really was and still is the gold standard.
sentences.zh: 市面上确实有布兰诺克测量仪的仿制品。

sentences.en: There are Brannock device copycats out there.
sentences.zh: 专利几十年前就过期了，所以公司对此无能为力。

sentences.en: The patent expired decades ago, so there's nothing the company can do.
sentences.zh: 这些仿制品是在材料和劳动力更便宜的海外制造的。

sentences.en: These imitations are made abroad in places where materials and labor are cheaper.
sentences.zh: 但它们的制造工艺也更廉价。

sentences.en: But they're also made more cheaply.
sentences.zh: 如果你在鞋店看到一个仿冒的布兰诺克测量仪，尤其是如果它用了几年以上，

sentences.en: If you were at a shoe store and saw a knockoff Brannock, especially if it was more than a few years old,
sentences.zh: 你就能看出区别，比如它的固定装置和配件的校准程度就不那么精细。

sentences.en: you could see the difference in terms of like the fixtures and the fittings just aren't as nicely calibrated.
sentences.zh: 你就能看出区别，比如它的固定装置和配件的校准程度就不那么精细。

sentences.en: It's not as well made.
sentences.zh: 它的做工没那么好。

sentences.en: Charles Brannock died in 1992 at the age of 89.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·布兰诺克于1992年去世，享年89岁。

sentences.en: He was a lifelong bachelor, married only to his invention, and he never invented anything else.
sentences.zh: 他终身未婚，只与他的发明“结婚”，而且他再也没有发明过其他任何东西。

sentences.en: It's really interesting to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说真的很有趣。

sentences.en: So many inventors, you know, they they get the bug to invent something and they they just keep going.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多发明家一旦迷上发明，就会不断地推陈出新。

sentences.en: Charles Brannock kind of nailed it on the first shot.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·布兰诺克算是第一次尝试就大获成功。

sentences.en: He was only in his 20s, his early 20s, and it was one and done.
sentences.zh: 他当时才20出头，刚出头，就完成了这一项发明，之后便再无其他。

sentences.en: Brannock had no children and no succession plan.
sentences.zh: 布兰诺克没有子女，也没有继任计划。

sentences.en: But keeping in line with their founders values, the company made a very unusual decision about how to move forward.
sentences.zh: 但为了秉承创始人的价值观，公司在如何继续经营的问题上做出了一个非常不同寻常的决定。

sentences.en: They set a fixed price for the sale of the company and they asked potential buyers to make their case.
sentences.zh: 他们为出售公司设定了固定价格，并要求潜在买家陈述他们的理由。

sentences.en: One requirement was that the new owner had a promise to keep manufacturing in Syracuse for at least five years.
sentences.zh: 其中一个要求是，新主人必须承诺在雪城继续生产至少五年。

sentences.en: It was almost like a job application.
sentences.zh: 这简直就像是一场求职面试。

sentences.en: Like, who is worthy to become the stew to become the steward of this iconic American product?
sentences.zh: 就像是在问，谁有资格成为这个标志性美国产品的守护者？

sentences.en: American manufacturing had been on the decline since the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 自20世纪80年代以来，美国制造业一直在走下坡路。

sentences.en: So this requirement wasn't just unusual.
sentences.zh: 所以这个要求不仅仅是不寻常。

sentences.en: It was making a statement.
sentences.zh: 它更是一种宣言。

sentences.en: The brand device company was saying that a sustainable American made product is still possible.
sentences.zh: 布兰诺克设备公司是在说，可持续的美国制造产品依然是可能的。

sentences.en: And the plan worked.
sentences.zh: 而且这个计划奏效了。

sentences.en: Half a dozen people applied to buy the company, most of them from the shoe industry.
sentences.zh: 有六个人申请收购该公司，其中大多数来自鞋业。

sentences.en: But there was this one guy named Salvador Leonardi.
sentences.zh: 但其中有一个叫萨尔瓦多·莱昂纳迪的人。

sentences.en: He was in manufacturing in upstate New York.
sentences.zh: 他在纽约州北部从事制造业。

sentences.en: He had a family company that was founded by his father in the 1940s.
sentences.zh: 他有一个家族企业，是他父亲在20世纪40年代创立的。

sentences.en: They were arguably even more specialized than the brand device.
sentences.zh: 可以说，他们比布兰诺克设备公司还要专业。

sentences.en: They made these metal frames for purses and handbags.
sentences.zh: 他们专门制造钱包和手提包的金属框架。

sentences.en: Like, if you can imagine how a handbag opens and closes the sort of metal frame around the flaps, that's what they made.
sentences.zh: 比如，你可以想象一下手提包是如何开合的，翻盖周围的那种金属框架，就是他们制造的。

sentences.en: That's a clutch purse style, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想那应该是手拿包的款式。

sentences.en: That's a really satisfying snap when it comes together like a clamshell.
sentences.zh: 当它像蛤蜊壳一样合上时，那种咔哒声真的很让人满足。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But Sal Leonardi wanted to go into business for himself, sort of have his own business, something that he could call his own.
sentences.zh: 但萨尔·莱昂纳迪想自己创业，拥有属于自己的事业，一些他可以称之为自己东西的事业。

sentences.en: And he thought, oh, this, you know, this is the perfect thing I can do.
sentences.zh: 他想，哦，这个，你知道，这就是我能做的完美的事情。

sentences.en: Sal Leonardi eventually passed the company down to his son-in-law, Tim Follett.
sentences.zh: 萨尔·莱昂纳迪最终将公司传给了他的女婿蒂姆·福莱特。

sentences.en: And both men really seem to embody what makes the brand device special.
sentences.zh: 这两个人似乎都真正体现了布兰诺克设备之所以特别的原因。

sentences.en: They are very low-key, kind of not flashy people.
sentences.zh: 他们非常低调，不是那种爱出风头的人。

sentences.en: And I don't mean that in a negative way.
sentences.zh: 我这么说并没有贬义。

sentences.en: On the contrary, they really believe that if you make a quality product, it speaks for itself.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反，他们坚信如果你制造出优质的产品，它自然会证明自己。

sentences.en: And I've interviewed them and known them for a while now.
sentences.zh: 我已经采访过他们，也认识他们有一段时间了。

sentences.en: And they believe strongly in the idea of you make it better, not faster.
sentences.zh: 他们坚信“做得更好，而不是更快”的理念。

sentences.en: You use good materials.
sentences.zh: 使用好的材料。

sentences.en: You hire good people.
sentences.zh: 雇佣优秀的人才。

sentences.en: And they are not sort of publicity seekers.
sentences.zh: 他们不是那种寻求曝光度的人。

sentences.en: And I think there's a lot to be said for that.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一点非常值得称道。

sentences.en: It seems almost inconceivable in today's marketplace of influencers and social media and, you know, all the rest where everything is hype, hype, hype,
sentences.zh: 在当今这个充斥着网红、社交媒体以及所有其他一切都在大肆炒作的市场中，这似乎令人难以置信，

sentences.en: and the attention economy and all of that.
sentences.zh: 还有注意力经济等等。

sentences.en: That is not how the Brannock device has been promoted.
sentences.zh: 但布兰诺克设备公司并不是那样推广产品的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, it's captured your attention, certainly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它确实吸引了你的注意力。

sentences.en: The Brannock device has captured my attention, too.
sentences.zh: 布兰诺克设备也吸引了我的注意力。

sentences.en: And there's one story about the Brannock device company that I think encapsulates my fascination with this object, both the design and what it says about business.
sentences.zh: 关于布兰诺克设备公司，有一个故事我认为概括了我对这个物体的着迷，无论是它的设计还是它所体现的商业理念。

sentences.en: About 20 years ago, current Brannock president Tim Follett saw an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 大约20年前，现任Brannock公司总裁Tim Follett看到了一个商机。

sentences.en: The discount chain Payless Shoe Source had started introducing foot-measuring devices into their stores for the first time.
sentences.zh: 折扣连锁店Payless Shoe Source当时开始首次在店内引入足部测量设备。

sentences.en: Here's Tim.
sentences.zh: 这就是Tim。

sentences.en: And they were considering the knockoffs.
sentences.zh: 当时他们正在考虑使用仿制品。

sentences.en: But these knockoffs weren't very good.
sentences.zh: 但这些仿制品的质量并不好。

sentences.en: They are poor quality.
sentences.zh: 质量很差。

sentences.en: Matter of fact, some of them send, actually, they send a little screwdriver with them and an extra screw.
sentences.zh: 事实上，有些仿制品甚至会随附一把小螺丝刀和一个备用螺丝。

sentences.en: I don't know how you could be an owner of any establishment.
sentences.zh: 我不知道身为一家机构的经营者怎么会接受这种东西。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's like getting your car with an extra transmission.
sentences.zh: 这就好比你买车时，对方还多送你一个变速箱一样。

sentences.en: And as a brand that relied on selling a large volume of cheap shoes, Tim knew that Payless needed a device that would stand up to abuse.
sentences.zh: 作为一个依赖销售大量廉价鞋履的品牌，Tim知道Payless需要一种经得起折腾的设备。

sentences.en: So I went to a local mall and I took a bunch of brand new devices, our brand new devices, and they actually had some knockoffs in the mall.
sentences.zh: 所以我去了当地一家商场，拿了一堆全新的设备，也就是我们的设备，而商场里正好有一些仿制品。

sentences.en: So I traded with the manager.
sentences.zh: 于是我跟经理做了交换。

sentences.en: I took the old broken ones and gave him some of ours.
sentences.zh: 我拿走了那些破旧的仿制品，给了他一些我们的产品。

sentences.en: Tim took those knockoff Brannock devices home, figured out who at Payless headquarters was in charge of purchasing them, and sent him the broken devices.
sentences.zh: Tim把那些仿制的Brannock设备带回家，查清了Payless总部负责采购的人员，并把那些损坏的设备寄给了他。

sentences.en: And I said, if you buy the knockoffs, this is what you're buying.
sentences.zh: 我对他说，如果你买仿制品，这就是你买到的东西。

sentences.en: And I said, in five years, this is what your store is going to be filled with.
sentences.zh: 我还说，五年后，你的店里就会堆满这种破烂。

sentences.en: And that reflects poorly on your store.
sentences.zh: 这会严重影响你们店的形象。

sentences.en: It's like going into a restaurant, a nice restaurant, and having broken chairs.
sentences.zh: 这就好比走进一家高档餐厅，却发现里面的椅子都是坏的一样。

sentences.en: It worked.
sentences.zh: 这招奏效了。

sentences.en: We ended up getting all of Payless' business for many, many years as an investment.
sentences.zh: 最终，我们获得了Payless多年来的全部业务，这算是一笔投资。

sentences.en: But you won't find a brand new device in a Payless these days.
sentences.zh: 但如今你在Payless店里已经找不到全新的设备了。

sentences.en: Because there are no Payless stores anymore.
sentences.zh: 因为Payless已经不存在了。

sentences.en: Yeah, they went out of business.
sentences.zh: 没错，他们倒闭了。

sentences.en: Payless went bankrupt in 2019 for a lot of reasons.
sentences.zh: Payless在2019年破产，原因有很多。

sentences.en: Mall traffic had plummeted.
sentences.zh: 商场客流量大幅下降。

sentences.en: They had a hard time competing with online companies like Zappos.
sentences.zh: 他们很难与Zappos这样的在线公司竞争。

sentences.en: But there's something else that contributed to the downfall of Payless, a trend that's been growing in the American financial system since the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 但还有其他因素导致了Payless的衰落，这是一种自20世纪80年代以来在美国金融体系中日益增长的趋势。

sentences.en: Private equity.
sentences.zh: 私募股权。

sentences.en: Here's where I'm going to go on a bit of a digression.
sentences.zh: 接下来我要稍微离题一下。

sentences.en: But I assure you, I'll eventually tie it back to the beautiful simplicity of the Brannock device in the Brannock device company.
sentences.zh: 但我向你保证，最终我会把它与Brannock设备及其公司那美妙的简洁性联系起来。

sentences.en: You may have heard private equity linked to the fight over Taylor Swift's masters.
sentences.zh: 你可能听说过私募股权与Taylor Swift音乐版权之争有关。

sentences.en: Or you might remember that 2012 presidential candidate Mitt Romney had been the CEO of a private equity firm called Bain Capital.
sentences.zh: 或者你可能还记得2012年总统候选人Mitt Romney曾是一家名为Bain Capital的私募股权公司的首席执行官。

sentences.en: And private equity encompasses a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 私募股权涵盖的内容非常广泛。

sentences.en: But what most people mean when they talk about it is something called a leveraged buyout.
sentences.zh: 但大多数人在谈论它时，指的其实是一种叫做“杠杆收购”的东西。

sentences.en: Here's the basic idea.
sentences.zh: 基本概念是这样的。

sentences.en: A private equity firm identifies a company that they want to buy.
sentences.zh: 一家私募股权公司确定他们想要收购的目标公司。

sentences.en: And they get a sale price for that company.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会谈定一个收购价格。

sentences.en: But the key here is that the private equity firm pays only a portion of that sale price, usually between 10% and 30%.
sentences.zh: 但关键在于，私募股权公司只支付收购价格的一小部分，通常在10%到30%之间。

sentences.en: The rest of the sale is covered by a loan from a bank.
sentences.zh: 剩余的收购款由银行贷款支付。

sentences.en: So in that way, it's kind of like a home mortgage.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上说，这有点像房屋抵押贷款。

sentences.en: Except with a leveraged buyout, the company being bought is taking on the debt of the loan.
sentences.zh: 只不过在杠杆收购中，被收购的公司需要承担这笔贷款的债务。

sentences.en: They're the ones incurring the risk.
sentences.zh: 他们才是承担风险的一方。

sentences.en: Private equity firms pick companies they feel have steady revenue, but room for improvement.
sentences.zh: 私募股权公司会挑选那些他们认为收入稳定但仍有提升空间的公司。

sentences.en: The firm installs their own leadership to restructure the business.
sentences.zh: 公司会安插自己的管理团队来重组业务。

sentences.en: And the goal is to make the company stronger and to sell it again at a profit.
sentences.zh: 目标是让公司变得更强大，然后再将其高价卖出以获利。

sentences.en: But often, the restructuring means layoffs and other big cuts.
sentences.zh: 但重组往往意味着裁员和其他大规模削减开支。

sentences.en: And taking a company and saddling them with a ton of debt right away can make these turnarounds really difficult.
sentences.zh: 而且，收购一家公司并立即给它背上沉重的债务，会让这些扭亏为盈的努力变得非常困难。

sentences.en: Especially if the company is already struggling.
sentences.zh: 尤其是当这家公司本身就已经陷入困境时。

sentences.en: Toys R Us, Joanne's Fabrics, Sports Authority, Radio Shack.
sentences.zh: 玩具反斗城（Toys R Us）、Joanne's Fabrics、Sports Authority、Radio Shack。

sentences.en: All these companies and their employees are victims of leveraged buyouts.
sentences.zh: 所有这些公司及其员工都是杠杆收购的受害者。

sentences.en: And then, there's Payless.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们聊聊Payless。

sentences.en: In 2012, a group of private equity firms purchased Payless for $2 billion.
sentences.zh: 2012年，一家私募股权投资集团以20亿美元收购了Payless。

sentences.en: They saw an opportunity to modernize a legacy chain.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了将这家老牌连锁店现代化的机会。

sentences.en: Payless was turning a profit under this new ownership.
sentences.zh: 在新的所有权下，Payless开始盈利。

sentences.en: But that wasn't enough.
sentences.zh: 但这还不够。

sentences.en: Private equity firms want to make money for their investors.
sentences.zh: 私募股权公司要为他们的投资者赚钱。

sentences.en: Not just when they sell the company down the line, but they want to make money right away.
sentences.zh: 不仅是在未来出售公司时，他们还想立刻赚到钱。

sentences.en: So Payless had to pay dividends to their new shareholders, which ended up erasing all the profits they made.
sentences.zh: 因此，Payless不得不向新股东支付股息，这最终抹去了他们赚取的所有利润。

sentences.en: Any money that could have gone to their workers or passed along to the consumers in the form of better products or cheaper prices went straight to the investors.
sentences.zh: 任何本可以发给员工，或以更优质的产品、更低廉的价格回馈给消费者的钱，都直接进了投资者的腰包。

sentences.en: This was the beginning of the end for Payless.
sentences.zh: 这是Payless走向终结的开始。

sentences.en: Payless filed for bankruptcy in 2019.
sentences.zh: Payless于2019年申请破产。

sentences.en: They closed all their U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们关闭了美国所有的

sentences.en: stores.
sentences.zh: 门店。

sentences.en: They laid off thousands of workers in those stores.
sentences.zh: 他们解雇了这些门店里的数千名员工。

sentences.en: And hundreds more in the company's Kansas headquarters.
sentences.zh: 还有公司位于堪萨斯州总部数百名员工。

sentences.en: Compare that to the Brannock device company.
sentences.zh: 再来看看Brannock测量仪公司。

sentences.en: You don't have to have a huge product line.
sentences.zh: 你不需要拥有庞大的产品线。

sentences.en: You make this one thing.
sentences.zh: 你只做这一样东西。

sentences.en: You specialize in it.
sentences.zh: 你专注于它。

sentences.en: You're good at it.
sentences.zh: 你把它做好。

sentences.en: You know, people know you for it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们因为这个而认可你。

sentences.en: Your customers keep coming back to you for it.
sentences.zh: 你的客户会因为这个不断回头找你。

sentences.en: And it puts food on the table for you and your employees.
sentences.zh: 它能让你和你的员工维持生计。

sentences.en: The invention of the Brannock device and the company's consistent production of a quality product that could stand up to years of use and abuse in a shoe store and their commitment to making that product in the U.S.
sentences.zh: Brannock测量仪的发明，公司始终如一地生产出能经受住鞋店多年使用和磨损的优质产品，以及他们坚持在美国制造该产品的承诺。

sentences.en: In Syracuse, New York.
sentences.zh: 在纽约州的雪城。

sentences.en: A commitment so strong that it transcended the life of the founder, Charles Brannock.
sentences.zh: 这种承诺如此坚定，以至于超越了创始人查尔斯·布兰诺克的生命。

sentences.en: And even that they didn't sell to the highest bidder.
sentences.zh: 甚至他们也没有把公司卖给出价最高的人。

sentences.en: You know, that they weren't just trying to milk this product or this estate, you know, for the highest price they could get.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们不仅仅是想榨干这个产品或这份家业，你知道，为了能得到的最高价格。

sentences.en: All these things represent an array of deeply held values.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都代表了一系列根深蒂固的价值观。

sentences.en: Dare I say, American values.
sentences.zh: 我敢说，这是美国式的价值观。

sentences.en: They aren't and never were exclusive to the U.S., but they are values at the center of the stories we like to tell about ourselves.
sentences.zh: 它们并非、也从未是美国所独有的，但这些价值观是我们喜欢讲述的关于我们自己的故事的核心。

sentences.en: That sort of worked.
sentences.zh: 那种模式曾经奏效。

sentences.en: That vision or version of capitalism and manufacturing worked for a long time.
sentences.zh: 那种资本主义和制造业的愿景或版本曾长期行之有效。

sentences.en: And it's really not the economy we have now in America.
sentences.zh: 但这确实不是我们现在美国所拥有的经济模式。

sentences.en: The modern American business doesn't have room for all these values.
sentences.zh: 现代美国企业没有容纳所有这些价值观的空间。

sentences.en: The value of quality, the value of taking care of workers, the value of community, the value of honoring the wishes of the founder.
sentences.zh: 质量的价值、关怀员工的价值、社区的价值、尊重创始人意愿的价值。

sentences.en: In the modern world of private equity, those have all been reduced to one value.
sentences.zh: 在私募股权的现代世界里，这些都被简化为一种价值。

sentences.en: Shareholder value.
sentences.zh: 股东价值。

sentences.en: I think that is a loss.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种损失。

sentences.en: And it's one of the reasons why the 100-year existence of the Brannock device company means something to me.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么Brannock测量仪公司能存在100年对我而言意义重大的原因之一。

sentences.en: And it makes me happy that in 2026, they're doing okay.
sentences.zh: 让我感到高兴的是，到了2026年，他们依然经营得不错。

sentences.en: They still make $300 or $400 a week.
sentences.zh: 他们每周还能赚300到400美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: They tell me.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: The company does say it's quite a few years ago now that they sold their millionth Brannock device.
sentences.zh: 公司确实说过，那是几年前的事了，当时他们卖出了第100万台Brannock测量仪。

sentences.en: So they're well past a million in terms of the lifetime of the product.
sentences.zh: 所以就该产品的整个生命周期而言，他们早已突破了百万大关。

sentences.en: I'm pretty surprised by that stat of a $400 a week.
sentences.zh: 我对每周400美元这个数据感到相当惊讶。

sentences.en: That's very impressive.
sentences.zh: 这非常令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: I have to confess I was a little surprised by that as well, and I found it heartening.
sentences.zh: 我必须承认，我也对此感到有点惊讶，而且我觉得这很令人振奋。

sentences.en: So there is still a market out there, even with the knockoffs,
sentences.zh: 所以市场上仍然有需求，尽管有山寨货的存在，

sentences.en: and even with really the biggest challenge they've faced is the decline in brick-and-mortar shoe stores and the decline in malls.
sentences.zh: 而且他们面临的最大挑战其实是实体鞋店的衰落和商场的没落。

sentences.en: Because a lot of people don't go to the shoe store anymore to buy shoes or to have their kids buy shoes.
sentences.zh: 因为很多人不再去鞋店买鞋，或者带孩子去买鞋了。

sentences.en: They order on the internet, but in a nice, another one of these sort of parallel developments, just as shoe sales have moved from brick-and-mortar to the internet,
sentences.zh: 他们在网上订购，不过有意思的是，伴随着鞋类销售从实体店向互联网转移的平行发展，

sentences.en: Brannock sales have also moved from the shoe store to the internet.
sentences.zh: 布兰诺克测脚仪的销售也从鞋店转移到了互联网。

sentences.en: Yes, you can be like Paul and have your very own Brannock device.
sentences.zh: 是的，你可以像保罗一样，拥有属于你自己的布兰诺克测脚仪。

sentences.en: And they say that direct-to-consumer sales are now part of their business.
sentences.zh: 他们说，直接面向消费者的销售现在已经成为他们业务的一部分。

sentences.en: And that was something that was unheard of in Charlie Brannock's day.
sentences.zh: 这在查理·布兰诺克那个年代是闻所未闻的。

sentences.en: He was selling only wholesale to shoe stores.
sentences.zh: 他当时只向鞋店进行批发销售。

sentences.en: So that's an interesting thing that I like the thought that, you know, some people now have Brannock devices in their home.
sentences.zh: 所以这很有意思，我喜欢这种想法，你知道的，现在有些人把布兰诺克测脚仪放在家里。

sentences.en: And that's kind of a nice thing to see.
sentences.zh: 看到这一幕感觉挺不错的。

sentences.en: I think it's nice too.
sentences.zh: 我也觉得挺不错的。

sentences.en: This object, essentially unchanged, without corporate backing, indoors, not because it changed with the times, but because it is still the best at what it does.
sentences.zh: 这个物品基本上没有改变，没有大公司的支持，放在室内，不是因为它随时代而变，而是因为它仍然是同类产品中最好的。

sentences.en: And maybe it'll keep being the best, even after most of us are long gone.
sentences.zh: 也许它会一直保持最好，甚至在我们大部分人离去很久之后。

sentences.en: It'll be this exemplar of competency, as evidenced by visionary director George Miller.
sentences.zh: 它将成为卓越能力的典范，正如远见卓识的导演乔治·米勒所证明的那样。

sentences.en: In the 2015 film Mad Max Fury Road, Furiosa's rig uses a Brannock device as an improvised gas pedal.
sentences.zh: 在2015年的电影《疯狂的麦克斯：狂暴之路》中，弗瑞奥萨的重型卡车把布兰诺克测脚仪当成了临时油门踏板。

sentences.en: There are several close-up shots of the foot, you know, depressing this Brannock device that, you know, that powers the rig.
sentences.zh: 镜头有几个特写，拍的是脚，你知道的，踩着这个布兰诺克测脚仪，你知道的，以此来驱动卡车。

sentences.en: And I thought that was kind of ingenious.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这挺绝妙的。

sentences.en: It's so cool because it's a testament to the fact that these things are so well made and that they last through the apocalypse and will serve as the gas pedal.
sentences.zh: 这太酷了，因为它证明了这些东西质量极佳，能够挺过末日浩劫，并作为油门踏板继续服役。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: The indestructible Brannock device, the thing that's going to, as you say, survive the apocalypse.
sentences.zh: 坚不可摧的布兰诺克测脚仪，正如你所说，它将历经末日而不朽。

sentences.en: Many thanks to Paul Lucas for knowing absolutely everything there is to know about the Brannock device.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢保罗·卢卡斯，他几乎了解关于布兰诺克测量仪的一切知识。

sentences.en: You can find more of Paul's writing at inconspicuous.info.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 inconspicuous.info 网站上找到更多保罗的文章。

sentences.en: His logo is, of course, a Brannock device.
sentences.zh: 他的标志当然就是一个布兰诺克测量仪。
